summary: Apply the run profile before delivery setup, count only available and few slots as open, pace and count redirect hops, and state the Go 1.26.9 minimum in the README.
reason: Publish review (PR #2292): a --deliver saved in a profile never ran; unknown slots showed as open; followed redirects skipped the rate limiter and request budget; the docs stated Go 1.26.6 while go.mod needs 1.26.9.
call_sites: Set up delivery after the run profile is applied
Each followed hop is a real request
validated_outcome: go vet and go test ./... pass, including new redirect-budget and slot-summary tests; a profile-saved --deliver file:... now creates the file.
